chapters.title: The founding
chapters.text:
Mingirdas, Daugirdas, Máhte, Máhte, Lempi, Máijá, Thorfrid Ketilsdóttir, Vaimantas, Inghild and Dervorgilla were among those who arrived in summer.

Mingirdas worked as a woodworker. Daugirdas, Máhte and Dervorgilla worked as hunters. Máhte, Lempi, Máijá, Thorfrid Ketilsdóttir and Vaimantas worked as fishers. Inghild worked as a farmer.

The founding party had two adult does and one adult buck and 1 longship.

Máhte and Máijá were already partners. Their first households lived in tents.
